Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
albert1642 wrote:
> 1.) Bauble weapons... What's the cost of them? If somebody called a vote,
> Peace Treaty, how much would you pay? 0 right?

You'd pay full cost. The cost of the equipment is not reduced (as with Black
Cat), you simply don't pay it when it enters play through Bauble.

> 2.) Wolf Companion states each strike resolution, does that include additional
> strikes?

No. Effects that happen 'each strike resolution' only happen during 'normal'
strike resolution.

> 3.) Can you call the prince action 'Blood Hunt' on muaziz/archons? I know it's
> a play of words, but the prince action 'Blood Hunt' is blood hunt non the
> less...

Yes, you can. Text on Muaziz/Archon refers only to the Blood Hunt referendum.

> 4.) If somebody mind rapes a vampire, and was ousted before his next minion
> phase... Mind rape is never burnt, correct?

Correct.

> 5.) Madness network, is your minion taking their turn considered as your next
> minion phase? (Working on the mind rape thing)

No.

> 6.) If Renegade Garou has 2 life at my untap... Can I tap the Vagabond Mystic
> to first give him 1 blood then have the Renegade Garou own ability give him
> another? (Since I choose the order that is... ) I'm pretty sure you can't,
> but since I do choose the order and the vagabond mystic can be tapped during
> any time... It could be done, maybe... right?...

You order events during your untap as you wish, so yes.

Flux

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
albert1642 wrote:
> 1.) Bauble weapons... What's the cost of them? If somebody called a vote,
> Peace Treaty, how much would you pay? 0 right?

The cost is as printed on the weapon card.

> 2.) Wolf Companion states each strike resolution, does that include additional
> strikes?

No. It includes only the initial normal (non-First Strike) strike resolution
phase of each round.

> 3.) Can you call the prince action 'Blood Hunt' on muaziz/archons? I know it's
> a play of words, but the prince action 'Blood Hunt' is blood hunt non the
> less...

Yes. If word play is the game: the Blood Hunt action isn't "called".

> 4.) If somebody mind rapes a vampire, and was ousted before his next minion
> phase... Mind rape is never burnt, correct?

Correct.

> 5.) Madness network, is your minion taking their turn considered as your next
> minion phase? (Working on the mind rape thing)

No.

> 6.) If Renegade Garou has 2 life at my untap... Can I tap the Vagabond Mystic
> to first give him 1 blood then have the Renegade Garou own ability give him
> another? (Since I choose the order that is... ) I'm pretty sure you can't,
> but since I do choose the order and the vagabond mystic can be tapped during
> any time... It could be done, maybe... right?...

No.
You could tap the VM to give him a life, but then he would no longer gain one
from his special, since he no longer has less than 3 life.
